target.title: refactor(android): remove orphaned sheet composer
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Removes a legacy Android chat-sheet composer that remained after its sole caller, `ChatSheetContent`, was deleted. Keeping the second implementation left two `ChatComposer` paths to maintain even though only the private composer in `ChatScreen` is reachable.

## Why This Change Was Made

Deletes the orphaned internal composable, its private UI helpers, sheet-only draft/command plumbing, and tests that only exercised those dead paths. The live `mergeChatDraft` helper and the private `ChatScreen` composer remain unchanged; the native string inventory is regenerated to drop the deleted UI literals.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior changes. Android chat continues to use the canonical private composer in `ChatScreen`, with less dead code and no duplicate maintenance surface.

## Evidence

- Repo-wide static search found no current call, import alias, callable reference, reflection string, preview, sheet, or canvas use of the internal composer. The only matching call uses the private `ChatScreen` signature.
- History confirms the sole matching caller was removed in `cb7468fc58a` (#102809).
- Blacksmith Testbox through Crabbox `tbx_01kx46sdead62pekyw8gszvj58`:
  - `corepack pnpm native:i18n:check`
  - `corepack pnpm android:i18n:check`
  - `corepack pnpm apple:i18n:check`
  - `cd apps/android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --build-cache :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatComposerDraftTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest`
  - `cd apps/android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --build-cache :app:ktlintCheck`
  - `cd apps/android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --build-cache :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest :app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest :app:assemblePlayDebug :app:assembleThirdPartyDebug :app:lintPlayDebug :app:lintThirdPartyDebug :benchmark:assembleDebug :app:ktlintCheck :benchmark:ktlintCheck`
- After rebasing onto current `main`, the native/Android i18n checks and focused unit tests passed again on the same Testbox.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
- `git diff --check`
